title: Brazilian Shrimp Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy Brazilian-inspired stew made with succulent shrimp, vegetables, and a hint of zesty flavor. Perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.

ingredients.name: Brazilian Stew Spice
ingredients.notes: available at most grocery stores or online

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped yellow pepper and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the Brazilian stew spice, tomato paste, and stew tomatoes.
Stir well and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
